account_partner_leads_meta_description: Write down the numbers of customers about to sign up and see where each one is on the road.
account_partner_leads_hero_lead: Write down the number of someone who is about to sign up; if they come with that number, they're registered under your name.
account_partner_leads_nobody_bubble: Write down your first customer's number and we'll follow them!
account_partner_leads_nobody_body: Write a number in the form; whoever comes, you'll see their road here.
account_partner_leads_how_rule_shared: If several partners write down the same number, the first one stays.
account_partner_leads_how_rule_link: If a customer comes through a partner's link, the link comes first.
account_partner_leads_how_rule_name: After sign-up you see the customer's name, but not the price or their dog.
account_partner_leads_how_rule_commissio: For each buyer, you see your commission here, and whether it has been paid.
account_partner_leads_form_inactive: Your partnership is paused for now; new numbers can't be saved.
account_partner_leads_form_line_listen: Go ahead, I'll note it down!
account_partner_leads_form_phone_invalid: That mobile number isn't right; write it like 09123456789.
account_partner_leads_error_not_saved: Couldn't save it. Check the number and try again.
account_partner_leads_error_signed_out: You've been signed out. Refresh the page and sign in again.
account_partner_leads_error_forbidden: Numbers can't be saved for this account. If you think that's a mistake, let {trainer} know.
account_partner_leads_error_internal_wit: Couldn't save it. Try again. Reference code: {errorId}
account_partner_leads_error_network: Couldn't save it. Check your internet connection and try again.
account_partner_leads_error_body: Something went wrong. Open the page again or check back in a few minutes.
